title: Incident Beacon: service degradation index and causal stitching dashboard
creator: Marcus Chen
description:
Problem: On-call and reliability teams spend too long correlating independent telemetry slices (latency spikes, model rejections, HTTP/gRPC error codes, queue length) for multi-tenant inference surfaces. Current dashboards show isolated signals, but lack a unified scoring and causal stitching view that surfaces likely root causes across layers (network, infra, runtime, model).

Goal: Build an 'Incident Beacon' dashboard that computes a Service Degradation Index (SDI) per route/service and provides causal stitching links to traces and metric families. The SDI is a lightweight, explainable score combining: SLA breach exposure (SLO%), early-error signal amplification (error-rate delta), request fanout/backpressure ratio, and model rejection ratios. The dashboard should guide operators to the most probable failure class (timeout, overload/backpressure, model error, protocol errors) and provide one-click tracehook slices and recommended playbook actions.

Scope: prototype SDI computation, dashboard UI panels (overview heatmap, time series lanes, causal hint panel), tracehook integration to produce focused traces, and a small triage playbook template per failure class. This ticket covers backend metric aggregation, enrichment mapping, dashboard panels, and initial playbook content.

Out of scope: long-term ML signal detectors, automatic mitigation (rollbacks/autoscale), and historical ML drift analysis (separate project).
acceptance_criteria: SDI computed for all production routes and visible in the dashboard with configurable weighting (defaults provided)
Overview heatmap shows top 30 routes by SDI and allows filtering by customer/org tier and region
Each SDI row has a causal-hint column indicating probable failure class (timeout | overload | model_error | protocol_error) with confidence score
Clicking a causal-hint opens a tracehook slice pre-filtered to the 5 most relevant traces (by error fingerprint or high-latency sampling)
Dashboard links to a short triage playbook for each failure class with suggested next steps and relevant runbooks
End-to-end test: simulate a latency spike + increased model rejections in staging and confirm SDI ranks affected route in top 5 and causal hint points to model_error
Docs: brief README in the observability repo explaining SDI formula, config knobs, and how to add new signal sources
tasks: Define SDI formula and default weights; document rationale and boundary cases
Add metric transforms in the metrics pipeline (rate deltas, rolling percentiles, fanout/backpressure ratio)
Create enrichment mapping to translate low-level faults to candidate failure classes
Instrument tracehook endpoint to accept SDI-based slice requests and return prioritized trace ids
Build dashboard panels: heatmap, per-route detail, causal-hint strip, trace list modal
Create triage playbook snippets and linkable runbook anchors
Add e2e test scenario in staging harness and automated check for SDI ranking
